subject: mathematics
content: The line of shortest distance between the lines $$\frac{x-2}{0}=\frac{y-1}{1}=\frac{z}{1}$$ and $$\frac{x-3}{2}=\frac{y-5}{2}=\frac{z-1}{1}$$ makes an angle of $$\cos ^{-1}\left(\sqrt{\frac{2}{27}}\right)$$ with the plane $$\mathrm{P}: \mathrm{a} x-y-z=0$$, $$(a>0)$$. If the image of the point $$(1,1,-5)$$ in the plane $$P$$ is $$(\alpha, \beta, \gamma)$$, then $$\alpha+\beta-\gamma$$ is equal to _________________.
